# Danav

> One brain, every model. Super Intelligence you own, on hardware you own.

Danav is a local-first cognitive infrastructure and autonomous agent operating system built 100% in Rust (Core Engine) and Tauri v2 + React (Desktop & Web Control Center). It turns fragmented AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Codex, Ollama) into a unified, privacy-preserving intelligence system operating on user-owned hardware.

## Architecture

Danav operates as a unified two-part platform:

1. **Danav Brain (`danavd` / `danav` CLI):**
   - Headless, single-binary daemon written 100% in Rust.
   - Serves as the cognitive hippocampus (relational memory graph + Tree-sitter AST code index).
   - Serves as the prefrontal cortex (sub-50ms TypeSafe System one decision router + streaming OpenAI/Anthropic API proxy).
   - Integrates with any AI tool via stdio/SSE MCP server and localhost proxy at `127.0.0.1:7420`.

2. **Danav Desktop Application (`Danav Desktop`):**
   - Native cross-platform application built on Tauri v2 and React.
   - Bring Your Own Subscription (BYOS) pool manager for Claude, Codex, Gemini, and local Ollama models.
   - Visual Agent Studio, DAG Workflow Compiler, and OS/Browser accessibility automation bridge.
   - Offline-capable with zero telemetry and zero cloud lock-in.

## Key Capabilities

- **One Brain, Every Model:** Shared local relational memory graph (`UPDATES`, `EXTENDS`, `DERIVES`) across all IDEs, CLIs, and agents.
- **Sub-15ms Surgical Context Pack:** Turn-1 prompts receive a deterministic 400–600 token `<danav_context_pack>` containing exact AST symbol line ranges and test states, cutting token consumption by up to 80%.
- **Sub-50ms TypeSafe System one Engine:** Evaluates routing, safety gating, and tool selection using constrained zero-text primitives (`Choice`, `Score`, `Noul`) with a 0% structural hallucination guarantee.
- **BYOS Agent OS:** Orchestrates background agents across GitHub, Notion, Slack, email, and desktop applications using existing subscriptions without SaaS markups.
- **Local Security Sandbox:** Rootless execution, strict outbound secret redaction, and taint enforcement across DAG pipeline transitions.

## Key Performance Metrics

- Single-Binary Size: `< 35 MB` (Rust stripped release)
- Turn-1 Context Pack Latency: `< 15 ms` (P95)
- System one Decision Pass: `< 45 ms` (P95 on CPU via quantized ONNX)
- Proxy First-Token Overhead: `< 5 ms` over upstream API
- Idle RAM Footprint: `< 60 MB` (CLI Daemon) / `< 150 MB` (Desktop App)
- Structural Hallucination Rate: `0.0%` on internal routing & tool selection
